source_binding_evidence: selected-source.json; revision linkage is artifact metadata, not independent remote Git verification

method.derivatives: Pillow native-resolution tiling/cropping with grey file/coordinate labels, no resampling; originals untouched
method.full_page_ranges: All full-page pixels covered by non-overlapping source-coordinate tiles. Tiles may split text at artificial boundaries; reviewed across adjacent tiles. Fixed-position overlays are part of the source screenshot.

verdict: The captured pixels are reviewable and contain no identified blocking visual defect in the reviewed scope. The machine assertion gate is failed and remains unresolved in this run. This review is not release approval or public deployment verification.

findings.subject: Coverage and integrity
findings.result: 87 image files decode successfully and match artifact-manifest.json SHA-256. All 42 required full/banner images and 15 keyboard focus images, plus home-mobile.png, were visually inspected (58 source files).

findings.subject: Responsive text and composition
findings.result: All 15 route/viewport pairs are represented. Native-pixel full-page review found no horizontal clipping of page layout, broken Korean glyphs, collapsed text, intersecting cards, or price labels wrapping across lines. Desktop two-column product/category cards become one column on mobile. Header branding and menu-open control remain readable at 320 and 390 px.

findings.subject: Nine banner placements across three widths
findings.result: All 27 focused captures show their banner fully within the visible middle region, with preserved 2:1 composition, readable main headline/phone number, intact floral imagery, and no duplicate text caption beneath the banner. Message appears after opening/purpose content and before products; budget follows products and precedes venue guidance; consultation follows FAQ and precedes sources.

findings.subject: Product photographs, prices and CTA labels
findings.result: Home shows all eight products; each detail page shows the appropriate four. All 48 card appearances across three widths contain visibly loaded photographs, product names, SKU labels, single-line base prices, and readable underlined detail CTA labels. C204 and C205 images are visibly present. Screenshot pixels alone do not validate href targets or destination availability.

findings.subject: FAQ, source sections, footer and recovery page
findings.result: All three main content pages show expanded readable FAQ answers, separated questions, source links and bottom consultation CTA. The dark footer and its links are visible in full-page captures, except some pixels obscured by the fixed mobile bar in the 390 px 404 full-page composite. 404 recovery actions are present. Reading the pixels does not independently verify the real-world business facts stated in page copy.

findings.subject: Keyboard focus appearance
findings.result: All 15 keyboard-first captures show a clear rose-colored focus outline. Home focuses the first opening CTA; other routes focus the breadcrumb Home link. Focused target is visibly clear of the fixed header and mobile action bar in each sample.

findings.subject: Interaction behavior
findings.result: report.json records 351 keyboard samples, passing Space/Enter open-close sequences for all 10 mobile route/viewport pairs, and footer visibility checks. The pixel reviewer did not run a browser or independently reproduce those interactions. The five desktop menu checks are inapplicable menu-hidden checks, not five additional mobile tests.

findings.subject: Missing dynamic screenshot evidence
findings.result: No expanded-menu screenshot or dedicated final-scroll mobile-footer screenshot was identified. Current full-page mobile captures retain the fixed bottom bar at initial viewport coordinates, obscuring the underlying band of content in the composite. This is a capture limitation and is not, by itself, proof of permanently inaccessible content. Full keyboard traversal and skip-link behavior are runner-report-only.

findings.subject: Failed machine gate and public release
findings.result: This run remains machine-qa-failed: 17 product CTA/image-containment assertions across 7 route/viewport pairs. The reviewed pixels show the images rendered later, but do not convert that run to a pass. Public deployment, public HTTP, production behavior, other browsers, additional breakpoints and external destinations were not verified by this review.

reuse_rule: A later successful run may inherit only findings supported by identical screenshot bytes or identical decoded RGB dimensions and pixels, with an explicit per-file comparison record. Source revision and route/viewport roles must still match. Changed image files require renewed pixel inspection. Unverified dynamic behavior never becomes directly verified through screenshot reuse.
